Peak memory counter on Neuron tracks physical on-device slices, not Python-side outstanding DataPtrs. With the async lazy allocator, Python can queue alloc ops faster than the worker materializes them, so the peak physical count during the hot loop legitimately exceeds the warmup peak. The upstream CUDA-authored assertion peak_mem1 == peak_mem2 assumes synchronous Python-side accounting and does not hold for Neuron's asynchronous allocations.
